value.rationale: The naturally induced O(1) rim cuts and spoke marks give an exact law for the outbreak fraction from a unique hub, while the smallest Poisson gap produces a distinct and sharp lambda^2 full-connectivity threshold. For mu~alpha lambda^2, reached fraction approaches one but all-terminal connectivity has nontrivial limit exp(-1/alpha). The finite-network reliability versus macroscopic coverage separation is a motivated structural phenomenon, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
